A small studio. A considered approach.

Useful by design.
Personal by nature.

We’re DigitalSprout, an independent software studio in the UK. We make focused apps for real routines: keeping a journal, managing a collection, remembering the details, or making something new.

Each app has a job to do. Our job is to make it feel simple.

Meet the studio

A few useful answers

Before you
dive in.

Visit the support hub
Where can I download your apps?

Open an app’s page to find its verified App Store or Google Play links. Availability and device compatibility can vary by app and region; the store listing has the latest details.

Are your apps free?

Pricing varies by app. Some apps include optional purchases or subscriptions. Check the store listing and the purchase screen for the current price and included features.

How do I get help with an app?

Visit our support hub or email info@digitalsprout.org with the app name, your device and a description of the problem.

Where can I find privacy information?

Every app page links to its own privacy policy and available terms. You can also find them together in our app policy directory.

A question, an idea, a little help?

There’s a real person on the other end.
